question: GQ-009
subject: auditing the decisions I have been asking Shaan to make
why: Seven decisions have sat unanswered all day while I worked on the things they describe. I never checked whether they were still accurate. A decision queue that drifts is worse than an empty one — it asks for judgement on a situation that no longer exists.

5.said: Six registered God Questions have no testable contract. Testable contracts: 1 of 7.
5.actual: 7 of 7 carry success criteria, falsifiers and watch triggers. I wrote them.
5.action: Marked RESOLVED in place, struck through, original text retained below it.

6.actual: 4.68 GB today, hourly rate rising, and 91% of it is this agent. Root at 16Gi.
6.action: Header rewritten with the measured rate, the attribution, and the per-request override lead.

7.said: IA expansion is blocked on a rights judgement.
7.actual: Rights was never the blocker for the 270,049 texts carrying an explicit IA rights field. Selection was, and the Library answers it from its own book_subject table. An 81-identifier want-list now exists.
7.action: Header rewritten; the original text retained since it stands for the sparse-metadata cases.

the_counter_defect.symptom: After marking decision 5 resolved, awaiting_decision.count stayed at 7.
the_counter_defect.cause: blockedDecisions() counts every "## N." heading. A struck-through heading still matches.
the_counter_defect.consequence: A resolved item would have been reported as pending forever — the observatory would have kept asking Shaan for something already done.
the_counter_defect.fix: Filter headings starting with ~~ or containing RESOLVED.
the_counter_defect.proven: Struck through decision 2 as a fixture: count went 6 -> 5, then back to 6 on restore.
